text.en:
The Agno High School in the Municipality of Agno, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby
converted into a national high school to be known as the Agno National High School.

The Ministry of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby directed to take the necessary steps for
the conversion and operation of said school and the immediate implementation of this Act.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1983
